newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Anesta raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Anesta raised to buy.

text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said on Wednesday it raised its rating on shares of Anesta Corp to buy from long-term attractive based on the belief that Anesta will file for approval of its cancer pain drug, Actiq, ahead of schedule.
-- Actiq would be the first drug for treating cancer pain, the investment firm said in a statement.

-- The firm said Actiq should generate sales of $30 to $50 million in its first full year. The stock should trade at 7- to 9-times sales, giving it a market capitalization of $320 million and stock price of $35 a share by 1998, it said.
-- Anesta currently trades around $14 a share.
